description: Continuous diffusion generates complete reasoning solutions through iterative refinement in latent space. We introduce Latent Flow Reasoning Models (LFRMs), an ELF-based training and inference recipe. Our experiments show that accurate decoding alone does not ensure strong reasoning performance. We therefore learn compact representations from multiple layers of a strong autoregressive teacher. Their decomposition also enables asynchronous denoising at different rates.
